summary: Recorded the repair attempt for the Node-wrapper proposal lead and kept it unresolved. The source account is unchanged (the proposal channel is closed when an applied change removes the local node and is re-opened only by a leadership change with a leader known, so a change that adds the node back leaves it closed). New in this update are two diagnosed defects of my own harness, which is why no execution is requested: the probe read the wrapped node's raft fields from the test goroutine while its run loop was mutating them, and one snapshot reported an impossible pair (committed_index 3 with last_index 0), so those readings are inadmissible; the fix is to take every snapshot through the node's status channel and to keep only app-visible endpoints (Propose's return value and duration, the leader's own index) from the test goroutine. Second, the native run did not show the wrapped node processing the leader's initial append within a three second wait (it reported term 0 and no leader while the leader's log had advanced, and only reported term 1 later, after the configuration-change pump), so the premise of the comparison - a member that knows the leader - cannot be established with the current harness. The interpretation stays unresolved with defect_claim unresolved, counterevidence keeps the documented 'proposals can be lost' allowance and notes that both observed blocks happened in states whose premise was unconfirmed, and the limitations now state the two harness repairs needed before a receipt would be meaningful. The harness file remains in the draft for that repair; the two other questions' accounts are unchanged and remain backed by their receipts.
